heard: Saturn has an icy moon shaped like a sponge. When Cassini arrived in 2005, its craters looked wrong. A normal impact blasts debris everywhere, but this moon has almost none. The secret? Roughly 40% of Hyperion is empty space. Because its porous ice meteors don't blast debris outward, they punch directly inward, compressing the ice like foam. Gravity from giant Titan also forces the moon into a chaotic tumble. Its axis wobbles in a spin that's completely unpredictable. That unpredictable spin is unique to this giant cosmic sponge.
